title: SegQC Evaluation Report v0
description: Machine-readable Stage-7 evaluation-report schema v0 for segqc.eval.report (item 056). Bundles item 054's cohort-level metrics plus optional item 055 calibration outcome and caller-supplied provenance.

schema_version.description: Version discriminator for this evaluation-report schema. Always '0.1' for v0 reports.

provenance.description: Caller-supplied identity/reproducibility metadata for this report.

metrics.description: The CohortMetrics.to_dict() bundle (item 054): confusion counts, FPR/sensitivity/specificity, per-failure-mode sensitivity, and the two correlation results.

calibration.description: Optional summary of the chosen calibration outcome (item 055). Absent when the report was built without a CalibrationResult.

provenance.description: Report provenance: cohort identity/size, the config version that produced the metrics, and a caller-supplied build date. No wall clock is ever read.

cohort_id.description: Free-text identifier for the evaluated cohort.

cohort_size.description: Number of cases in the cohort; equals metrics.n_cases.

config_version.description: The HeuristicConfig.schema_version that produced the metrics.

build_date.description: Caller-supplied ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' build date. Never derived from the wall clock.

reference_schema_version.description: Optional schema_version of the reference distribution used, if any. Null when not applicable/unknown.

segqc_version.description: Optional segqc package version string. Null when not supplied.

metrics.description: The CohortMetrics.to_dict() bundle (item 054). Nested shapes (counts, per_mode entries, correlation results) are already guaranteed by CohortMetrics.to_dict() and are not enumerated leaf-by-leaf here.

calibration.description: The chosen calibration summary (item 055): status, objective, and the best candidate's assignment/achieved metrics. Deliberately not the full per-candidate sweep.

objective.description: The CalibrationObjective used to score every candidate.

best.description: The selected best feasible candidate's assignment + achieved metrics, or null when no candidate was feasible.
